description: Multi-branch management: Branch CRUD page, branch context provider, branch selector in TopNav, and data filtering by active branch
steps: Create src/hooks/useBranches.ts with TanStack Query hooks (useBranches, useCreateBranch, useUpdateBranch, useDeleteBranch) following the exact pattern in src/hooks/useProducts.ts but querying the 'branches' table

Create src/contexts/BranchContext.tsx - a React context that stores the currently selected branch_id (persisted in localStorage), exposes currentBranch and setCurrentBranch, and a 'all branches' option. Follow the pattern in src/contexts/SidebarContext.tsx

Create src/pages/settings/BranchesPage.tsx - a full CRUD page for branch management with DataTable listing all branches (name, code, city, phone, is_active), a create/edit Dialog with form fields (name, code, address, city, state, country, phone, is_active), and delete confirmation. Follow patterns from src/pages/settings/UsersPage.tsx and src/pages/inventory/Products.tsx. Use react-hook-form + zod for validation.

Add a BranchSelector dropdown component in src/components/layout/BranchSelector.tsx - a Select dropdown showing all active branches plus an 'All Branches' option, using the BranchContext to read/write selected branch. Style it to match the dark glassmorphism design.
Integrate BranchSelector into src/components/layout/TopNav.tsx - add it to the left side of the top nav actions area, before the search button
Wrap the app with BranchProvider in src/main.tsx, placed inside AuthProvider
Register the BranchesPage route in src/App.tsx at path 'settings/branches' with lazy loading
Add 'Branches' nav item to the Settings section in src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx using the Building2 icon from lucide-react, placed after the 'Users' entry

Create supabase/migrations/008_branch_enhancements.sql that adds a 'branch_id' column to warehouses table (if not already present) with FK to branches, and adds branch_id to products table for branch-specific products (nullable UUID with FK to branches)
acceptance_criteria: BranchesPage renders at /settings/branches with a DataTable of branches and a working create/edit dialog
BranchSelector appears in TopNav and persists selection to localStorage
Sidebar shows 'Branches' link under Settings section
pnpm build succeeds with no TypeScript errors
verification: Run 'pnpm build' and confirm it succeeds with exit code 0
Run 'pnpm lint' and confirm no errors
findings: pnpm build succeeds (exit 0). pnpm lint has 10 pre-existing issues (4 errors in netlify/functions and services/ai, 6 warnings in sales pages) that exist on the base branch without any of these changes. Added BranchProvider to eslintrc allowExportNames to avoid triggering react-refresh warning. The Branch type in database.ts was missing code and state fields - added them to match the SQL schema. Used regular Dialog for delete confirmation since @radix-ui/react-alert-dialog is not installed.
